faq.heading: Frequently asked
faq.sub: Common questions about translating between English and Turkish.

items.q: Does it handle Turkish letters like ı, ş, and ğ correctly?
items.a: Yes, Turkish-specific letters appear correctly in both the written translation and what gets spoken aloud.

items.q: Can it translate spoken Turkish back to English?
items.a: Yes — speak Turkish into the mic and get an English translation as text, with audio playback available.

items.q: Does it get Turkish word order and suffixes right?
items.a: Yes, it produces natural Turkish sentences with the correct suffix chains, not a literal word-for-word swap.
Yes. The service is free for everyone — no subscription and no quota. Sign in with email, Google or Apple only if you want your history attached to an account instead of this browser.

items.q: Do I need a Turkish keyboard installed?
items.a: No, the app handles Turkish letters automatically — no special keyboard needed.

items.q: Can I hear how the Turkish translation is pronounced?
items.a: Yes, tap the speaker icon on any translation to hear it read aloud.
